formats.description: Render one file per format from the same scenes: landscape 1920x1080, vertical 1080x1920, square 1080x1080. Omit to render only `format`. fps always comes from `format`.

hyperframes.description: Pinned HyperFrames version for npx, for example 0.8.84

file.description: Path relative to the run folder

offset.description: Seconds to skip into the track

at.description: Video time where the track starts

facts.description: Every number, price, and id shown on screen, as short phrases; checked by qa.mjs facts

loudness.description: Integrated LUFS for final.mp4; false skips normalization

sfx.description: Global SFX track from scripts/sfx-cues.mjs, mixed under the joined video at 0 s

file.description: Path relative to the run folder

line.description: What this scene says or shows, one line, used in TIMING.md

composition.description: motion and logo: sub-composition path relative to composition/, default compositions/<id>.html

source.description: demo: footage path relative to the run folder

hold.description: Seconds into the scene where render-scenes --stills captures the hold frame. Default 0.5s before the cut.

focus.description: demo: crop center as fractions of the source frame when its shape differs from the output, default { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }

faceRect.description: demo: speaker's face as [x, y, w, h] fractions of the frame, checked by the face gate

states.description: One-shape morph scene: states in order, local times

variables.description: Values the composition reads: copy, colors, logo path

assets.description: Extra files (relative to the run folder) whose change should trigger a re-render
